children: TotalEnergies could meet its below 10% gearing objective one quarter earlier than the end of 2026 target it set out at September's Investor Day, HSBC analyst Kim Fustier writes. Gearing is a way to measure a company's financial health and typically, the higher the gearing the less financially secure a company is. Quarterly cash flow from operations is set to benefit from an exceptional downstream performance and rebounding LNG prices. The French energy major's net debt should fall by around $7.0 billion on the prior quarter to $12.8 billion, she writes. This is almost $5 billion lower than HSBC's prior forecast and would push gearing down to 8.6% from 13.1% in the second quarter.(adam.whittaker@wsj.com)
